$comment: Star systems. M1 ships one; the full galaxy of twenty is authored in M3. Names, regions and port assignments come from spec section 19.

systems.name: Parity
systems.description: The clearing house of settled space. Nothing is mined here and nothing is grown here; everything is priced here.

ports.name: the Bourse
ports.description: A ring of counting floors built around the original beacon. Every quote in the Reach is struck here first and arrives everywhere else late.

ports.name: Underwriters' Hall
ports.description: Insures every hull that matters and most that do not. The Hall is listed on its own exchange, which nobody there finds remarkable.

systems.$comment: Star and port radii are visual sizes in world units, not astronomy: a top-down view draws them at a fixed scale, so a true-scale star would be wider than the screen at any distance.
